name: Email to tasks
summary: Read new email from people on your board and propose follow-up tasks.

routes.how: Install gog and sign in to the intended Gmail account
probe: import subprocess,json,sys; p=subprocess.run(["gog","auth","list","--json"],capture_output=True); d=json.loads(p.stdout) if p.returncode==0 else {}; sys.exit(not (d.get("accounts") if isinstance(d,dict) else d))

flow.title: Once a day
flow.text: Runs on the shared automation schedule.

flow.title: Read Gmail
flow.text: Read only, through your gog login. Only exact addresses of board contacts.

flow.title: Find new messages
flow.text: A small script lists new message IDs as hashes. No AI is used and no email text is stored.

flow.title: Find follow-ups
flow.text: An agent reads each matching message and spots clear next steps.

flow.title: Review Inbox
flow.text: Tasks and contact notes wait there as proposals. It never sends or changes email.
